_comment: ng-zorro-only classes that antd v6 CSS does not style. `input`/`select`/`space` entries are wave-1 alignment work: remove them as those components are aligned (sub-project 2).
_button_comment: button's entries are permanent, not wave-1 work: antd v6's own React Button emits ant-btn-color-link and the legacy ant-btn-{default,dashed,link,text,dangerous,rtl} type/danger/rtl classes for backward compatibility, but its v6 CSS never styles them (verified against node_modules/antd/es/button/style). class-coverage.spec.ts pins this exact set so it can't silently grow.
